metas.name: The Entity
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

A woman is tormented by an invisible being.

metas.name: Rebel Moon - Part One: A Child of Fire
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

When a peaceful settlement on the edge of a distant moon finds itself threatened by a tyrannical ruling force, a stranger living among its villagers becomes their best hope for survival.

metas.name: First Man
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

A look back at the life of astronaut Neil Armstrong and the legendary space mission that led him to become the first man to walk on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

metas.name: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A group of 30-year-olds who have been friends since high school attempt to throw an end-of-summer orgy.

metas.name: My Best Friend Is a Vampire
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

After a sexual encounter with a beautiful client, a teenage delivery boy finds himself being turned into a vampire.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: Stonehearst Asylum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

When Dr Edward Newgate arrives at the asylum to begin his residency, he finds the Dr in charge has adopted unusual methods of treatment, methods that give his patients a lot of freedom. But cracks appear in the hospital's cheerful...

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

metas.name: Begotten
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

Presented in a surreal, gory and entirely visual manner, Begotten tells of the death of religion, the abuse of nature by Man and a nihilistic outlook on what life ultimately is.

metas.name: Alien: Resurrection
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Two centuries after her death, a powerful human/alien hybrid clone of Ellen Ripley aids a crew of space pirates in stopping the aliens from reaching Earth.

metas.name: Marooned
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

Three American astronauts are stranded in space when their retros won't fire. Can they be rescued before their oxygen runs out?

metas.name: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

86-year-old Irving Zisman takes a trip from Nebraska to North Carolina to take his 8 year-old grandson, Billy, back to his real father.

metas.name: Dracula: Dead and Loving It
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

Mel Brooks' parody of the classic vampire story and its famous film adaptations.

metas.name: Code 3
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

A burnt-out two-man paramedic crew and their student trainee ride-along embark on a 24-hour shift that exposes the funny, tragic, and broken aspects of the health-care system.

metas.name: A Scanner Darkly
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

metas.name: The Thursday Murder Club
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

Four irrepressible retirees spend their time solving cold case murders for fun, but their casual sleuthing takes a thrilling turn when they find themselves with a real whodunit on their hands.

metas.name: It Ends
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: Riddick
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Left for dead on a sun-scorched planet, Riddick finds himself up against an alien race of predators. Activating an emergency beacon alerts two ships: one carrying a new breed of mercenary, the other captained by a man from Riddick...

metas.name: Apollo 10½: A Space Age Childhood
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

A coming-of-age story set in the suburbs of Houston, Texas in the summer of 1969, centered around the historic Apollo 11 moon landing.

metas.name: Head Above Water
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A prominent judge, his wife, her ex-lover, and their neighbor encounter a dead body that complicates their lives.

metas.name: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Af...

metas.name: The Art of Self-Defense
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

After being attacked on the street, a young man enlists at a local dojo, led by a charismatic and mysterious sensei, in an effort to learn how to defend himself from future threats.

metas.name: Open Grave
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man wakes up with no memory in a pit full of dead bodies in the wilderness and must determine if the murderer is one of the strangers who rescued him, or if he himself is the killer.

metas.name: A Shot in the Dark
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

After a murder that took place in an influential millionaire's mansion, clumsy French Inspector Jacques Clouseau falls in love with the main suspect, Maria Gambrelli, and is determined to clear her name.

metas.name: Insidious: Chapter 2
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

The Lamberts believe that they have defeated the spirits that have haunted their family, but they soon discover that evil is not beaten so easily.

metas.name: Alien³
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Returning from LV-426, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on the maximum-security prison Fiorina 161, where she discovers that she has unwittingly brought along an unwelcome visitor.

metas.name: Destination Moon
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

"Destination Moon", tells the tale of when Doctor Charles Cargraves and retired General Thayer approach Jim Barnes, the head of his own aviation construction firms to help build a rocket that will take them to the moon.

metas.name: Married to the Mob
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A mobster's wife who hates her lifestyle gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed - if the Long Island mob and the FBI will only let her.

metas.name: The Fearless Vampire Killers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

A noted professor and his dim-witted apprentice fall prey to their inquiring vampires, while on the trail of the ominous damsel in distress.

metas.name: I Care a Lot
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

A crooked legal guardian who drains the savings of her elderly wards meets her match when a woman she tries to swindle turns out to be more than she first appears.

metas.name: The Island
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

metas.name: Psych 3: This Is Gus
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

In preparation for a shotgun wedding before the birth of Baby Guster, Shawn and Groomzilla Gus go rogue in an attempt to track down Selene's estranged husband, as Lassiter grapples with the future of his career.

metas.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: Voyagers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A crew of astronauts on a multi-generational mission descend into paranoia and madness, not knowing what is real or not.

metas.name: Gravity
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

Two astronauts must survive in space after their shuttle is hit by debris during a spacewalk.

metas.name: Clerks II
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A calamity at Dante and Randal's shops sends them looking for new horizons - but they ultimately settle at the fast food empire Mooby's.

metas.name: Tales of Terror
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

Three tales of terror involve a grieving widower and the daughter he abandoned; a drunkard and his wife's black cat; and a hypnotist who prolongs the moment of a man's death.

metas.name: The Joneses
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

A seemingly perfect family moves into a suburban neighborhood, but when it comes to the truth as to why they're living there, they don't exactly come clean with their neighbors.

metas.name: Die Alone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Tells the story of a young man who has amnesia. He bands together with a rugged survivalist in a zombie-like outbreak to find his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Honey Pot
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

In Venice, a millionaire hires an actor to help him prank three greedy ex-girlfriends into thinking he's dying and leaving his fortune to one of them.

metas.name: Don't Move
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

A seasoned killer injects a grieving woman with a paralytic agent. She must run, fight and hide before her body shuts down.

metas.name: Predators
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A group of elite warriors parachute into an unfamiliar jungle and are hunted by members of a merciless alien race.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

Astronaut Sam Bell has a personal encounter toward the end of his three-year stint on the Moon, where he, working alongside his computer, GERTY, sends home a resource that has helped diminish Earth's power problems.

metas.name: The Package
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

When a group of teenage friends goes on a spring-break camping trip, an unfortunate accident sets off a race against time to save one friend's most prized possession.

metas.name: Dark Shadows
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: Kinds of Kindness
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

A man seeks to break free from his predetermined path, a cop questions his wife's demeanor after her return from a supposed drowning, and a woman searches for an extraordinary individual prophesied to become a renowned spiritual g...

metas.name: I Am Legend
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Years after a plague kills most of humanity and transforms the rest into monsters, the sole survivor in New York City struggles valiantly to find a cure.

metas.name: The Trouble with Harry
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

Harry's dead and, while no one really minds, everyone feels responsible. After Harry's body is found in the woods, several locals must determine not only how and why he was killed but what to do with the body.

metas.name: The Evil
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

A doctor buys a Civil War era dilapidated mansion, and hires a few friends to fix it up, but the mansion hides a deadly secret.

metas.name: Pandorum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Two crew members of a spaceship wake up from hypersleep to discover that all their colleagues are missing. Despite this, it appears that they are not alone.

metas.name: Deep Impact
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

A comet is discovered to be on a collision course with Earth. As doomsday nears, the human race prepares for the worst.

metas.name: Soul Men
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

Though it's been about twenty years since they have spoken with one another, two estranged soul-singing legends agree to participate in a reunion performance at the Apollo Theater to honor their recently deceased band leader.

metas.name: The Little Shop of Horrors
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

A clumsy young man working at an impoverished flower shop discovers that the strange plant he has been nurturing has an insatiable appetite for blood, forcing him to kill to feed it.

metas.name: Joker
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Parasite

Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

metas.name: The Bay
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Chaos breaks out in a small Maryland town after an ecological disaster occurs.

metas.name: How to Rob a Bank (and 10 Tips to Actually Get Away with It)
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Clue

Caught in the middle of a bank robbery, a slacker and a bank employee become the ones who arbitrate the intense situation.

metas.name: Lights Out
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Obsession

A supernatural entity reemerges to terrorize a family when the lights go out at night.

metas.name: Pitch Black
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A transport ship crashes and leaves its crew stranded on a desert planet inhabited by bloodthirsty creatures that come out during an eclipse.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Apollo 13

An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Horrible Bosses
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

Three friends conspire to murder their awful bosses when they realize they are standing in the way of their happiness.
